# Abstract

This demo page presents qualitative speech enhancement examples for MARSE and related baselines.

# Method

The tables below hardcode all referenced audio examples with simple inline HTML audio players.

};
const datasetSelect = document.getElementById("dataset-select");
const sampleSelect = document.getElementById("sample-select");
function updateSamples() {
  const samples = datasetSamples[datasetSelect.value];
  sampleSelect.innerHTML = samples.map((sample) => `<option value="${sample}">${sampleLabels[sample]}</option>`).join("");
  updateSections();
}
function updateSections() {
  const selected = sampleSelect.value;
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-sample-section]").forEach((section) => {
    section.hidden = section.dataset.sampleSection !== selected;
  });
}
datasetSelect.addEventListener("change", updateSamples);
sampleSelect.addEventListener("change", updateSections);
updateSamples();
</script>
